newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar remains soft, closes easier.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar remains soft, closes easier.

text.p: London white sugar futures remained easier during Wednesday evening trading, and nearby contracts finished weak around their lows.
Traders said the New York market's failure to maintain upside momentum weighed on LIFFE sentiment, where trade sellers on nearby contracts dominated much of the activity.
Earlier hedge sales were seen against the European Union's weekly tender for export licences and then the lacklustre raws performance compounded the weakness, they said.
December ended at $318.20, down $1.60, while March shed an identical amount to close at $315.20. Turnover was 2,300 lots.
